row.evidence: Pitch's pricing page lists 'SAML-based SSO & SCIM' under Enterprise (+30 seats, Contact us); the help centre says 'Pitch offers System for Cross-domain Identity Management for customers on our Enterprise plan.'
row.notes: Status changed from unknown to gated: SCIM is now documented on Enterprise (Contact Sales, 30+ seats) and delivered through WorkOS Directory Sync. Plans changed since June: tiers are now Free, Plus (single member), Team (1-25 seats), Business (1-200 seats) and Enterprise; June's 'Pro $17/u/mo annual' no longer exists. The pricing page served EUR only (pitch.com/pricing/us and /pricing/usd returned 404 to plain requests and the headless renderer could not load pitch.com), so prices are recorded in EUR and numeric USD fields stay null. Plus is skipped as team plan because it allows one member. SAML SSO is Enterprise-only and set up by Pitch support via WorkOS. Pitch's REST API covers presentations, templates and links only, with no user management endpoints. IdP setup uses WorkOS's Okta/Entra SCIM guides, so idp is via_generic; no Okta or Entra catalogue app found.

operations.notes: Docs say 'Provision and de-provision users' and 'Sync user profile changes'; HTTP verbs not documented. update recorded in row as true.

roles.how: All provisioned users become workspace creators

limitations.text: No role assignment via SCIM; all provisioned users are workspace creators.
SCIM is not self-serve: it must be enabled by Pitch via the customer success manager and configured in WorkOS.

scim.notes: Delivered through WorkOS Directory Sync; Pitch does not publish its own SCIM base URL or token details. Enablement is requested via the customer success manager.

user_api.notes: Pitch's public REST API (templates, folders, teamspaces, presentations, links, current workspace) has no user, member or role endpoints in its OpenAPI spec, so no user-management API.

okta.notes: okta.com/integrations/pitch/ returns 404; Pitch points to WorkOS's Okta SCIM guide.

entra.notes: No Microsoft Learn pitch-tutorial or pitch-provisioning-tutorial (404); Pitch points to WorkOS's Entra ID SCIM guide.

fallbacks.notes: Members are otherwise invited manually from the workspace.
